End turn in hero form. Threat is only 2/7 on main scheme, and Jessica Jones (2 HP) or Black Cat can defend Rhino's Charge attack. Note: Charge has overkill, so defending with Jessica Jones (2 HP) means excess damage hits hero. Let's check HP: 7 HP. Rhino ATK is 6 + boost. Undefended is 6+boost = 7-9, which could defeat hero! Defending with hero: DEF 3 takes 6+boost-3 = 4-5 damage, leaving Spider-Man at 2-3 HP. Readying happens before villain phase! So Spider-Man will be ready to defend!
Keep Enhanced Spider-Sense to cancel treacheries.

Defend with Jessica Jones (2 HP). Charge gives overkill, so excess damage goes to Spider-Man. With 2 HP absorbed, total damage to hero will be ATK + boost - 2 = 6 + boost - 2 = 4 + boost. Hero has 7 HP, so hero survives unless boost is 3! Even better: Black Cat has 1 HP, Jessica Jones has 2 HP, hero DEF reduces by 3. Defending with Spider-Man directly reduces by 3, but hero exhausts and cannot attack for 2 next turn. Defending with Jessica absorbs 2, keeps Spider-Man ready! But wait, if boost is 2, 6+2=8, Jessica absorbs 2, Spider-Man takes 6 damage, leaving him at 1 HP. If boost is 3, 6+3=9, 9-2=7, Spider-Man is defeated! Is there a 3-boost card in Rhino's deck? Yes (e.g. some cards or Assault/etc.). Defending with hero is DEF 3, so damage taken is 6+boost-3 = 3+boost. If boost 3, damage is 6, Spider-Man lives at 1 HP with 100% certainty! And in hand next turn we have Swinging Web Kick (8) + Haymaker (3) = 11 damage, which is lethal on Rhino! We don't even need Spider-Man's basic attack! So defending with Spider-Man is 100% safe!
